module.description_full: The module imports product data to repricing.com. The data is used there for campaign management, feed optimization, dynamic repricing, Google Automated Discounts and CSV export.
module.additional_description:
With just a few clicks, this module imports all products into the connected repricing.com account. All product attributes, including all user-defined features, properties, etc., are captured.
 
Attributes can be combined as desired and assigned to freely definable fields. Optimized export templates are offered for the Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Microsoft Ads platforms so that feed-based product listing ads (Google Performance Max, Meta Retargeting & Lookalike, Microsoft Performance Max) can be run there via the integrated campaign manager. For all other advertising platforms and price comparison portals, export files can be created and retrieved automatically.
 
In addition, the imported product data can be used as a data source for the optionally bookable Dynamic Repricing and Google Automated Discounts.
 
Dynamic product groups enable the creation of sub-ranges based on filters that can be freely combined. The filters access all product attributes, performance data from the connected advertising platforms, and data from the optionally available repricing tool.
 
This allows the optionally available campaign manager to automatically run optimized advertising campaigns with different sales strategies. For example, campaigns that only promote products with high inventory levels, competitive prices, and high margins, or campaigns that focus on products with high inventory levels that need to be sold quickly. This ensures maximum efficiency in the use of advertising budgets at all times without the need for expensive advertising agencies.
 
Intuitive dashboards provide a quick overview of the performance of individual campaigns and aggregate the most important performance data per platform. In addition, all product attributes, performance data, and competitor prices are presented in tabular form and at the product level.
 
All functions in the repricing.com account can be booked by the user on a modular basis and can be activated/deactivated at any time. This enables maximum cost efficiency, making repricing.com perfect for small and medium-sized businesses. The module creates a repricing.com account. After importing the product data, the desired functions are selected and the system provides an exact preview of the monthly costs before a subscription is taken out. There is no contractual obligation.

  • Complete tool for product management, data feed optimization, and product data export to advertising platforms and price comparison platforms
  • Dynamic product groups for exporting data feeds with selected products, campaign management, and dynamic repricing
  • Intuitive to use: Modules and a modern user interface for time-saving operation without lengthy training
  • Optional value-added features: Campaign Manager, price comparison data, dynamic repricing, and automated discounts can be added at any time.

What is GDPR?
 
The GDPR is a new EU legal framework that governs how users' personal data is used. It applies to all automated and manual processing of personal data (i.e., collection, conservation, extraction, use, destruction, etc.).
 
Personal data is information that is used to identify an individual either directly or indirectly (i.e., first and last name, email address, IP address, telephone number, etc.).
 
Why choose our GDPR module?
 
The Official GDPR Compliance module by PrestaShop helps you bring your store into compliance with the GDPR. It meets the main obligations of the EU regulations concerning your customers' personal data, including:
 
  • The right to access their personal data and their right to portability
  • The right to rectification and deletion of their data
  • The right to retract their permission if it had been requested
 
It also allows you to keep a log of all your customers' activity concerning their private data (notably data accessibility, permission and deletion). You will be able to demonstrate your respect for the regulation's requirements.

module.name: dynamicrepricing
module.description: The module connects the shop backend with repricing.com and writes the calculated prices to the shop database
module.author: PrestaShop Partners
module.description_full: The module connects the shop backend with repricing.com and writes the calculated prices to the shop database.
module.additional_description:
A account is created via the module. After importing the products and selecting the desired functions, repricing.com displays an exact preview of the monthly costs. There is no contractual obligation, and all services can be canceled at the end of the month.

The module is used for data transfer; it receives the prices calculated in the account and writes them to the shop database.

The dynamic repricing feature from repricing.com continuously calculates the ideal selling price for each product. Various strategies, such as minimum price or average price, are available to choose from. This makes it easy to achieve different goals by selecting the strategy that best suits a particular product group. Whether the focus is on rapid stock clearance or maximizing profit margins for products in high demand, repricing.com offers the right functions.

Numerous filters are available for grouping products, based on product attributes from the shop system, performance data from the connected advertising platforms, and price comparison data. The various filters can be combined as desired. This makes it easy, for example, to group together all products with poor sales performance, high inventory levels, and high competitive pressure, and to boost sales and improve performance through a suitable repricing strategy.

Smart frequency is also controlled via the product groups. For products with low price volatility, it may be sufficient to collect competitor prices only once a week. Products with high price volatility and many competing suppliers, on the other hand, are checked daily and adjusted as necessary. Products are automatically assigned to the appropriate query group based on their price volatility, which increases the efficiency of repricing and reduces the costs of price data provision.

Price comparison data can be obtained from Google Shopping, Amazon and eBay. Users can adjust their selection of desired data sources in their account at any time, and sources can be combined with each other as desired.

With campaign management for Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Microsoft Ads, repricing.com offers the option of directly converting repricing-optimized prices into sales success. Product groups can also be used for this purpose. With just a few clicks, you can create a campaign that exclusively promotes products that you can offer at a competitive price. This makes significantly more effective use of your advertising budget, as approximately 80% of all sales go to the three providers that are best placed in price comparisons.

All functions of repricing.com are modular and can be activated or deactivated by the user at any time. The products for which price comparison data is obtained, the desired data sources, and the retrieval frequency can be adjusted by the user at any time. This makes repricing.com perfect for small and medium-sized businesses looking for a cost-effective, uncomplicated, yet powerful entry into automated price adjustment.

Highlights
  • Automated repricing based on competitors' prices on Google Shopping, Amazon, eBay & Google Automated Discounts prices
  • Various repricing strategies available: minimum price, average price, median, etc.
  • Unlimited number of repricing jobs with different strategies based on product groups
  • Smart freqencing: Automatic adjustment of the retrieval frequency for price data based on price volatility saves costs
  • Works perfectly with data feed manager from repricing.com
  • Repricing data can be used to automatically control advertising campaigns.

Pricing
Prices depend on the number of products and price data sources, as well as the selected update frequency. All three parameters can be freely configured by the user in their account and can be changed at any time. After selecting products, data sources, and configuring the update frequency, a price preview is displayed before completing a subscription. There is no contractual obligation.

REPLACE CLASSIC CAPTCHAS WITH CLOUDFLARE TURNSTILE TECHNOLOGY!
 
The security of your data entry forms is essential to protect you from various cyber attacks (bruteforce, DDoS, ...) and avoid the generation of fake accounts, spam, phishing, ... CLOUDFLARE TURNSTILE ADVANTAGES
 
Cloudflare's Turnstile technology offers great benefits:
 
  • A frustration-free user experience: Tests are transparent to users: no puzzles or challenges to solve, tests run in the background and do not disrupt the user experience. They work thanks to non-interactive JavaScript tests that are responsible for detecting the user's human behavior (analysis of the visitor's or browser's singular behaviors).
 
  • A technology adapted to all, regardless of their physical and cognitive abilities.
 
  • A GDPR compliant technology: no collection of sensitive data, no placement of cookies, no transfer of information outside the European Union. Turnstile only consults session data to validate the user's human behavior and relies on data from device manufacturers or machine learning models. Concerned about data privacy, Turnstile never looks for cookies (like a login cookie), nor does it use cookies to collect or store any information.
 
  • Free and available to everyone, whether or not you are a Cloudflare customer: Cloudflare Turnstile's sole purpose is to secure applications and websites. Even if you are not a Cloudflare customer, you can still use their secure form technology for your website. All you have to do is create a free account on their website.
 
AUTOMATIC INSTALLATION OF THE SECURITY CODE AND WITHOUT OVERRIDES

module.additional_description:
What is an MCP?

 

An MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the bridge that links AI to the real world — in this case, your store. This protocol allows the AI to understand your store’s context and become a true assistant capable of interacting with it.

 

For example, the MCP allows you to ask ChatGPT: "Analyze sales by product for the month of November and compare them to those of the previous month. Export your results to PDF format and send the file to me by email." The AI then uses the MCP to actually access your store, read and analyze your sales data, and send you its detailed report by email.

 

What is MCP Tools Plus?

 

Before talking about MCP Tools Plus, you need to understand what the MCP Server module for PrestaShop is. MCP Server is the MCP created by PrestaShop, which allows a compatible LLM (like ChatGPT) to help you manage your business by communicating with your store using the essential basic features defined by PrestaShop (you can read about them on the module's product page). Our module, MCP Tools Plus, is added to the PrestaShop module and brings enhanced features.

 

To use MCP Tools Plus, you must first install the PrestaShop MCP Server module. Once installed, you can connect our MCP Tools Plus module to MCP Server and activate the enhanced tools you need to manage your store from the AI.
